name: @dvc-labs/optimon
description: A Discord monitor and public metrics dashboard for the optiplex home lab.

scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --max-warnings 0 src && oxlint --config .oxlintrc.browser.json --max-warnings 0 web fallback deploy
scripts.format: prettier --write src test web fallback deploy scripts package.json tsconfig.json .github .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json .oxlintrc.browser.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test web fallback deploy scripts package.json tsconfig.json .github .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json .oxlintrc.browser.json
